tools.name: get_bank_holidays
tools.description: List the bank holidays (UK, from gov.uk) or public holidays (other countries, from Nager.Date) for a region in a year or between two dates, with weekdays and substitute days. Use it for questions like "When are the bank holidays in Scotland in 2027?". Ranges can be up to three years.

tools.name: leave_request_message
tools.description: Write the short, polite message asking a manager for the leave days of a break, in the same words as the Leave Hacker app. Pass the dates to book; the break's first and last day are worked out from the weekends (and bank holidays, if you pass region) either side unless you pass them.
